project.name: PanoptiCity
project.description: An interactive map to visualize surveillance camera coverage and field of view using OpenStreetMap data.

tags.description: Primary tag used to identify and import surveillance equipment nodes.
Ways and relations used as obstacles for the field of view simulation (building=roof is excluded).
Specifies camera hardware (fixed, dome, panning, panorama) to select the appropriate simulation model.
Type of mounting (wall, pole, ceiling, etc.) displayed in the camera details.
The horizontal viewing direction used to orient the field of view on the map.
The tilt angle of the camera lens, used to calculate the ground reach of the view.
Camera height in meters; critical variable for perspective and FOV calculation.
Alternative key used to determine camera height if the height tag is missing.
Specific type of surveillance (camera, ALPR, etc.) used for icon selection.
Defines the surveillance context (indoor, outdoor, public) to categorize the equipment.
Describes the type of area being monitored (traffic, town, entrance, etc.).
Alternative direction tag used if camera:direction is unavailable.
The entity responsible for operating the surveillance equipment.
